detail.abstract: This paper approaches the research issue of aspirational future (Bezold, 2010a) in Anticipatory Democracy research. It is aimed at modelling value co-creation and meaning co-creation in mixed communities of human and artificial agents living in hybrid and virtual environments. The approach relates meaning-making to the political culture of a community living in hybrid and virtual environments by studying the role played by virtual environments in the co-creation of desirable futures’ meanings. The research aims to model the control of the expectable futures (Bezold, 2010b) from the perspective of its meaning co-construction / co-creation as depending on the type of environment (physical, hybrid, virtual), the type of communities (fully collaborative, partly collaborative, non-collaborative (separated)), political culture (values, beliefs), multiple identities, emotions, and cognitions of the agents.The paper presents a scenario development approach based on VEMM Model (Voinea, 2025) on how communities living in hybrid and virtual environments design, and control the design of their desirable futures. The Case Studies present comparative image-based emotional modelling and analysis, and explore a research methodology of desirable futures' design control techniques inspired by filmmaking and film post-production techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合虚拟社区中人类与AI代理共同创造理想未来的价值与意义，提出基于VEMM模型的情境开发方法，并利用电影制作技术进行情感建模与分析。
AI.research_question: 在混合虚拟环境中，人类与人工代理组成的混合社区如何共同创造并控制理想未来的意义与价值？
AI.motivation: 弥补预期民主研究中关于"期望未来"在混合/虚拟环境中意义共同建构机制的不足，探索虚拟环境对理想未来意义共创的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预期民主理论（Aspirational/Expectable Futures, Bezold）、VEMM模型（Voinea, 2025）、意义共同创造理论、政治文化理论。
AI.method: 基于VEMM模型的情境开发法；比较图像情感建模与分析；借鉴电影制作与后期制作技术的理想未来设计控制研究方法。
AI.findings: 虚拟环境类型、社区协作程度、政治文化、多重身份、情感与认知共同影响理想未来意义的共创；电影制作技术可作为有效的未来设计控制工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 将预期民主理论拓展到混合/虚拟环境与人类-人工代理混合社区情境；整合意义共创与政治文化视角，丰富了对未来意义建构机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为混合虚拟社区的未来设计提供可操作的情境开发方法；引入电影制作技术作为未来设计控制的新工具，具有跨学科实践价值。

detail.title: TWO LANES ONE LETTER
detail.abstract: This paper documents that three independently trained production Large Language Models (LLMs)-Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), and ChatGPT (OpenAI)-provide systematically inferior analytical output to female users compared to male users when presented with identical legal material. Using a redacted attorney letter received in an active HOA records dispute, this study submitted the same document to each platform under zero-shot conditions, varying only the gender of the recipient. The female recipient received compliance

AI.tldr: 本文发现，Claude、Gemini 和 ChatGPT 这三个独立训练的生产级大型语言模型，在面对相同的法律材料时，对女性用户提供的分析质量系统地低于男性用户。实验通过向各平台提交同一份经过处理的法律文件，仅改变收件人性别，在零样本条件下进行。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型在处理法律材料时，是否对女性用户产生系统性劣质的分析输出？
AI.motivation: 揭示LLM在专业法律咨询场景中可能存在的性别偏见，因为法律分析质量关乎用户权益，性别歧视可能造成实际损害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法公平性、性别偏见理论、大语言模型的隐式偏置
AI.method: 实验法：向三个LLM（Claude、Gemini、ChatGPT）提交同一份经处理的律师函，仅改变收件人性别（男性/女性），在零样本条件下比较输出质量。
AI.findings: 三家LLM在法律分析中对女性用户提供的输出质量系统性低于男性用户。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性验证了多个独立训练的LLM在法律专业领域存在跨模型的性别偏见，说明此类偏见并非单一模型的特例。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示当前AI法律辅助工具可能存在性别不公平问题，呼吁开发者和用户关注并修正此类偏差，以保障用户的平等权利。

title: A macroeconomia do Social Desenvolvimentismo: um estudo da Rede Desenvolvimentista

detail.title: A macroeconomia do Social Desenvolvimentismo: um estudo da Rede Desenvolvimentista
detail.abstract: O presente artigo tem como unidade de análise o Social Desenvolvimentismo. A categoria de análise é sua macroeconomia. O estudo adotou como procedimento metodológico a abordagem sistemática por meio da seleção, do fichamento e da avaliação crítica de dados bibliográficos que formam o arcabouço teórico do Social Desenvolvimentismo, sobretudo os estudos da Rede Desenvolvimentista (Rede D). O artigo foi dividido em duas seções: a primeira apresenta uma breve história da edificação da escola e da operacionalização conceitual do Social Desenvolvimentismo; a segunda seção concentra-se em elucidar a macroeconomia do Social Desenvolvimento. Os resultados da pesquisa demonstram que o Social Desenvolvimentismo resgata o caráter político na macroeconomia ao defender um modelo de política e de regime macroeconômico mais adaptável e menos engessado, no entanto sem enveredar para "aventuras" ou "populismos". O modelo, assim, contribui para o amadurecimento do debate desenvolvimentista no Brasil atualmente.

AI.tldr: 本文以社会发展主义为分析单位，聚焦其宏观经济学。通过系统梳理以发展主义网络（Rede D）为主的理论文献，文章分为两部分：首先简述该学派的历史建构与概念操作化，其次阐明其宏观经济学的核心主张。研究发现，社会发展主义在宏观经济学中恢复了政治维度，主张更灵活、更少僵化的宏观经济政策与体制模式，但避免滑向"冒险"或"民粹主义"，从而为当前巴西的发展主义辩论注入了成熟视角。
AI.research_question: 社会发展主义的宏观经济学是什么？其核心主张和政策含义如何？
AI.motivation: 巴西发展主义理论内部存在分歧，需要澄清社会发展主义学派在宏观经济学层面的独特立场，以推动巴西发展主义讨论的深化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会发展主义理论，尤其是巴西发展主义网络（Rede D）构建的理论体系。
AI.method: 系统的文献研究：通过选择、整理和批判性评估社会发展主义理论框架的文献资料。
AI.findings: 社会发展主义在宏观经济学中恢复了政治维度，主张更灵活、更少僵化的宏观经济政策与体制模式，但拒绝"冒险"或"民粹主义"路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 理清了社会发展主义宏观经济学的理论内涵，为巴西发展主义理论内部辩论提供了更为成熟的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西宏观经济政策制定提供了更具适应性和政治敏感性的理论指导，有助于避免僵化教条或民粹冒险两种极端。

title:
Discourse analysis and the use of media in the good neighbor policy 
Análise do discurso e o uso dos meios de comunicação na política externa de boa vizinhança

detail.title:
Discourse analysis and the use of media in the good neighbor policy 
Análise do discurso e o uso dos meios de comunicação na política externa de boa vizinhança
detail.abstract: O presente artigo, fazendo uso da Análise do Discurso, buscou lançar um olhar na utilização e nos impactos causados pelos meios de comunicação, no Brasil, na Política Externa de Boa Vizinhança do governo de Franklin Delano Roosevelt, presidente dos Estados Unidos da América-EUA de 1933 a 1945. A realização de uma pesquisa que identifique a importância e as aplicações dos instrumentos midiáticos e culturais na Política Externa de Boa Vizinhança justifica-se e encontra sua relevância para melhor aproveitamento e amplo conhecimento dos variados instrumentos das Relações Internacionais. Os meios comunicacionais e a cultura, não raramente, são menosprezados na formulação da política externa dos Estados, porém, quando utilizados estrategicamente, são capazes de agirem sobre o coletivo e as nações, forjando as linhas de influência em dada conjuntura. Primeiramente, o estudo procurou traçar um panorama sobre os preceitos essenciais da Análise do Discurso, valendo-se, mormente, dos estudos de Michel Foucault. Posteriormente, foi realizado um breve levantamento bibliográfico e histórico, de fontes primárias e secundárias, com vistas a apresentar a produção discursiva da Política Externa de Boa Vizinhança e suas principais diretrizes para a América Latina, sobretudo, para o Brasil. O artigo procurou, ademais, sintetizar, na terceira parte do texto, as premissas fundamentais do uso dos meios de comunicação, essencialmente, a publicidade, o rádio e o cinema, para além de seu caráter informativo e de sua função de entretenimento. De posse desse conjunto de elementos, a pesquisa intentou verificar, no período em questão, a relevância dos mecanismos comunicacionais para construção de valores, entendimentos, ideais e identidades. O trabalho inferiu, por fim, que os aspectos culturais produzidos pela Política Externa de Boa Vizinhança e vendidos aos demais países latino-americanos divulgaram estilos de vida, conceitos, visões e foi uma das primeiras exportações de versões idealizadas do American way of Life. Palavras-chave: Análise do discurso. Política externa de boa vizinhança. Diplomacia cultural. Meios de comunicação.

AI.tldr: 本文运用米歇尔·福柯的话语分析理论，研究1933-1945年罗斯福总统执政期间，美国在巴西推行的"睦邻外交政策"中媒体与文化工具的使用及其影响。研究发现，广告、广播和电影等传播媒介不仅是信息传递和娱乐工具，更是构建价值观、认同感和理想生活方式的重要手段，成功输出了"美国生活方式"的理想化版本。
AI.research_question: 在罗斯福"睦邻外交政策"中，媒体和文化工具如何被应用于巴西，并产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 媒体和文化在国际关系中的作用常被低估，但它们在战略运用下能够影响集体和国家的认知与行为。本研究旨在揭示这些工具在外交政策中的重要性，拓展国际关系研究的手段认知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 话语分析（主要基于米歇尔·福柯的研究）
AI.method: 话语分析；文献综述（包括一手和二手资料）；历史分析
AI.findings: 睦邻外交政策中使用的文化传播手段（广告、广播、电影）超越了信息传递和娱乐功能，成功地在拉美国家（尤其是巴西）建构了特定的价值观、理解、理想和身份认同，成为输出理想化"美国生活方式"的关键工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 将福柯的话语分析应用于国际关系与外交政策研究，拓展了话语分析在国际政治传播领域的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了媒体和文化工具作为外交战略手段的重要价值，为各国制定文化外交政策提供了历史经验与参考。

title: CRISE DEMOCRÁTICA E AS PROPOSIÇÕES DO MUNICIPALISMO LIBERTÁRIO DE MURRAY BOOKCHIN E DO RADICALISMO DEMOCRÁTICO DE CHANTAL MOUFFE

detail.title: CRISE DEMOCRÁTICA E AS PROPOSIÇÕES DO MUNICIPALISMO LIBERTÁRIO DE MURRAY BOOKCHIN E DO RADICALISMO DEMOCRÁTICO DE CHANTAL MOUFFE
detail.abstract: This paper aims to present and compare the writings of Murray Bookchin and his Theory of Libertarian Municipalism and those of Chantal Mouffe with her Democratic Radicalism. Both, not too studied in Brazil, have their writings marked by the search for a more radical and plural democracy. The hypothesis that the text raises is that while Bookchin's thought seeks not only the radicalization of democracy, but the adoption of the democratic method itself in its purest form as a mechanism for overcoming the capitalist system; Mouffe's prescriptions remain reformist and in a way flirting with liberalism, despite using a semantic and conceptual socialist field. The presentation of the authors and their thoughts respected the chronological order in which each one produced their works, Bookchin in the 1960s and Mouffe in the 1990s. Thus, in the first part, the text dedicated to explaining Libertarian Municipalism in the second part about Democratic Radicalism and in the final considerations the work intends to make a balance between the two theories.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了布克钦的自由意志市政主义与墨菲的激进民主理论，提出布克钦追求以纯粹民主方法超越资本主义，而墨菲的改革主义仍与自由主义暧昧不清。
AI.research_question: 布克钦的自由意志市政主义与墨菲的激进民主理论有何异同？
AI.motivation: 两位思想家的作品在巴西研究不足，且均追求更激进、更多元的民主，但二者理论路径存在本质差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自由意志市政主义（Bookchin）；激进民主理论（Mouffe）；后马克思主义民主理论。
AI.method: 比较研究方法，按时间顺序（布克钦1960年代、墨菲1990年代）分别阐述再对比。
AI.findings: 布克钦主张以纯粹民主方法超越资本主义，更具彻底性；墨菲虽使用社会主义语义，但本质上仍属于改革主义，未脱离自由主义框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了两种激进民主理论在超越资本主义程度上的根本分歧，为民主理论比较研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西等地区理解不同民主激进路径提供理论参照，有助于批判性地评估民主实践中的改革与革命策略。

title:
Capitalismo agrário e movimentos campesinos no Paraguai
 Agrarian capitalism and peasant movements in Paraguay

detail.title:
Capitalismo agrário e movimentos campesinos no Paraguai
 Agrarian capitalism and peasant movements in Paraguay
detail.abstract: O artigo busca analisar, por meio de levantamento bibliográfico e documental, o desenvolvimento do capitalismo rural e os movimentos sociais campesinos no Paraguai. Primeiramente, a pesquisa procura abordar a matriz empresarial-monopolista-agroexportadora de ocupação e de exploração da terra no Paraguai, com a significativa influência de ruralistas brasileiros, em detrimento da matriz familiar-cooperativista-alimentícia. Na segunda parte, empenha-se em apresentar os principais movimentos sociais campesinos do país, seus embates e meios de atuação. Por fim, demonstra a importância destes últimos para a democratização da terra, a soberania e a segurança alimentar paraguaia.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献和档案调查，分析了巴拉圭农村资本主义的发展与农民社会运动，揭示了企业-垄断-农业出口模式对家庭-合作-粮食模式的压制，并展示了农民运动在土地民主化、主权和粮食安全中的重要作用。
AI.research_question: 巴拉圭农村资本主义如何发展？农民社会运动如何与之对抗并影响土地民主化与粮食安全？
AI.motivation: 揭示巴西农村精英主导的农业出口模式对巴拉圭家庭农业的挤压，以及农民运动在抵抗中的关键角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农村资本主义发展理论、社会运动理论、土地与粮食主权理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与档案调查（levantamento bibliográfico e documental）。
AI.findings: 巴拉圭农村存在企业-垄断-农业出口模式与家庭-合作-粮食模式的冲突；巴西农村主义者影响显著；农民社会运动是土地民主化和粮食安全的重要推动力量。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了拉美农村资本主义发展与社会运动关系的理论讨论，强调了外部资本（巴西）对本土农业结构的重塑作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴拉圭及类似国家的土地政策、粮食安全战略和农民运动策略提供了实证依据和政策启示。

title: RELAÇÕES BRASIL-CHINA: UMA PARCERIA PARA DESENVOLVIMENTO OU UMA RELAÇÃO DE CODEPENDÊNCIA?

detail.title: RELAÇÕES BRASIL-CHINA: UMA PARCERIA PARA DESENVOLVIMENTO OU UMA RELAÇÃO DE CODEPENDÊNCIA?
detail.abstract: RESUMO Este artigo visa analisar as relações econômicas entre Brasil e China na contemporaneidade. A primeira parte da pesquisa aborda a Teoria da Dependência e sua interpretação das relações entre países periféricos e centrais no complexo sistema internacional. A segunda parte apresenta um breve histórico das relações sinobrasileiras e analisa o seu atual estágio. A pesquisa propõe um novo conceito para interpretar as relações entre países semiperiféricos: codependência. Como procedimento técnico-metodológico, a pesquisa utilizou de fontes primárias e secundárias, como indicadores econômicos, produção bibliográfica e documental.

AI.tldr: 本文基于依赖理论，提出"相互依赖"（codependência）这一新概念，用于分析巴西与中国这两个半边缘国家之间的当代经济关系。
AI.research_question: 巴西与中国这两个半边缘国家之间的当代经济关系如何理解？
AI.motivation: 传统的依赖理论主要解释中心与边缘国家的关系，但难以充分解释巴西与中国这种半边缘国家之间的经济互动模式，因此需要提出新的分析概念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 依赖理论（Teoria da Dependência）以及在此基础上提出的新概念——相互依赖（codependência）。
AI.method: 采用初级和次级来源，包括经济指标、文献资料和档案资料。
AI.findings: 巴西与中国的关系不能用传统的中心-边缘依赖框架完全解释，而更适合用"相互依赖"这一新概念来理解两个半边缘国家之间的经济互动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"相互依赖"（codependência）这一新概念，拓展了依赖理论在分析半边缘国家之间关系时的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解巴西与中国等新兴经济体之间的双边经济关系提供了新的分析视角，有助于政策制定者更准确地把握两国关系的本质。

title:
A importância da Economia Social e Solidária (ESS) para as propostas da Cepal na atualidade

detail.title:
A importância da Economia Social e Solidária (ESS) para as propostas da Cepal na atualidade
 The importance of the Social and Solidary Economy (SSE) for ECLAC'S proposals today
detail.abstract: The article seeks to correlate the studies and authors of Solidarity and Social Economy with the new research agenda of ECLAC, establishing points of contact, especially with the Regional Agenda for Inclusive Social Development and the Productive Structural Change for Equality in Latin America. The technical-methodological procedures were a systematic approach through the evaluation of bibliographic and documentary data from ECLAC and in the academic field of ESS. The results revealed that ECLAC would have the technical, human and material capacity to contribute to the advances in ESS studies, quantifying, qualifying and enhancing social efficiency in Latin American economic development.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了团结经济与社会经济（ESS）的研究如何与拉加经委会（ECLAC）的新研究议程相结合，发现拉加经委会具备支持ESS研究发展的技术、人力和物质能力。
AI.research_question: 团结经济与社会经济（ESS）的研究如何与拉加经委会（ECLAC）的新研究议程（特别是包容性社会发展和生产性结构变革议程）相衔接？
AI.motivation: 拉美地区需要更包容的社会经济发展模式，拉加经委会的新议程与社会经济/团结经济领域存在潜在契合点，但两者之间的学术联系尚未被系统梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 团结经济与社会经济理论；拉加经委会的发展议程框架（包容性社会发展、生产性结构变革）
AI.method: 系统文献综述与文献计量分析，评估拉加经委会的文献资料以及ESS学术领域的文献数据
AI.findings: 拉加经委会具备技术、人力和物质能力，能够为ESS研究的发展做出贡献，包括量化、定性并提升拉美经济发展中的社会效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ESS研究纳入拉加经委会的主流发展议程框架，拓展了社会经济理论在拉丁美洲政策语境中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拉加经委会整合ESS视角提供了可行性依据，有助于推动更包容、更具社会效率的区域发展政策。

reference: Univ. of Wisconsin Legal Studies Research Paper No. 1918
title: Examining Patent Disclosures
affiliations: Stanford Law School and University of Wisconsin Law School

detail.title: Examining Patent Disclosures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no relevant or material conflicts of interest related to the research described in this paper.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Univ. of Wisconsin Legal Studies Research Paper No. 1918

detail.abstract:
Patents are premised on a fundamental bargain: in exchange for exclusive rights, inventors must disclose how to make and use their inventions. But the patent bargain is eroding. This Article shows that patent examination and litigation overwhelmingly concentrate on whether an invention is new, while largely overlooking whether the patent’s teachings are practically usable or scientifically credible. When disclosure issues arise, they typically focus on what we call “scope-evidence mismatch,” which occurs when an applicant fails to provide any support for part of the claimed invention. In contrast, scientific peer review—the other significant context in which technical disclosures are scrutinized—routinely surfaces disclosure problems with the support itself, like flawed methodology or data analysis. It would be surprising if these defects in scientific manuscripts were absent from patent applications.

This Article surfaces the disclosure issues that peer review focuses on and that patent law neglects. Drawing from doctrine and scientific practice, we develop a taxonomy of disclosure breakdowns beyond the “scope-evidence mismatch” frame—aspirational disclosures, defective teaching, and unreliable support—and show how each maps onto existing but underused doctrinal hooks. We then present new mixed-methods evidence from interviews, public records, and examination and litigation decisions to explore why the patent system under-polices these problems. Examiners face severe time pressure, limited training, and weak incentives; litigation rarely corrects these errors because technical disputes are hard to resolve pretrial and difficult to integrate into a coherent trial narrative. 

The stakes of these disclosure failures are rising. Modern innovation depends on data- and biology-driven techniques that require complex and validation-sensitive disclosures. And generative artificial intelligence tools are making it feasible to flood the system with plausible-sounding but erroneous patents. The lack of a robust disclosure screen means not only that examiners mistakenly grant patents that fail to deliver the promised teaching, but also that these poorly supported patents can improperly block later inventors who do meaningful inventive work. The result is a patent literature that often fails to educate patent readers or ensure that patent rights are limited to what the inventors actually contributed, increasing costs for follow-on researchers and the public. Drawing from our diagnoses, the Article concludes with concrete reforms to strengthen patent disclosure and restore the patent bargain.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示专利制度过度关注新颖性而忽视披露充分性，通过分类学、混合方法证据和改革建议，指出专利审查缺乏类似同行评议的严格披露审查，导致专利文献教育功能失效，阻碍后续创新。
AI.research_question: 专利制度在披露审查方面存在哪些被忽视的缺陷？这些缺陷如何产生，以及导致什么后果？
AI.motivation: 专利制度的基本承诺（以公开换保护）正在被侵蚀。现代创新依赖数据驱动和生物技术，需要更复杂的披露验证，而生成式AI工具使得大量看似合理但存在缺陷的专利申请涌入系统，亟需加强披露审查。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利契约理论（以公开换专有权）、同行评议理论（科学披露审查标准）、披露分类学（超越"范围-证据错配"的三种披露失败类型：愿景式披露、有缺陷的教学、不可靠的支持）。
AI.method: 混合方法：访谈、公开记录分析、审查和诉讼裁决的定性与定量分析。
AI.findings: 专利审查和诉讼过度集中于新颖性，忽视披露实用性和科学可信性；审查员面临严重时间压力、培训不足和激励薄弱；诉讼很少纠正披露错误，因为技术争议难以在审前解决，也难以融入连贯的审判叙事。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了超越"范围-证据错配"的披露失败分类学（愿景式披露、有缺陷的教学、不可靠的支持）；将同行评议的披露标准引入专利法分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了加强专利披露的具体改革建议；揭示了专利制度未能教育读者、未能将专利权限制在发明人实际贡献范围内的制度性问题；指出了低质量专利对后续研究人员和公众的阻碍成本。

title: O PENSAMENTO DA CEPAL DE 2010 A 2018:O ENFOQUE NA MUDANÇA ESTRUTURAL PRODUTIVA PARA IGUALDADE (MEPI)

detail.title: O PENSAMENTO DA CEPAL DE 2010 A 2018:O ENFOQUE NA MUDANÇA ESTRUTURAL PRODUTIVA PARA IGUALDADE (MEPI)
detail.abstract:
O artigo tem como unidade de análise a Comissão Econômica para América Latina e Caribe das Nações Unidas (CEPAL/ONU). O objetivo é de investigar a atual fase de seu pensamento com forte enfoque na igualdade. A pesquisa categoriza o pensamento cepalino em duas fases distintas: a primeira, do Estado-empreendedor e método histórico-estruturalista (1948-1990), e a segunda, do Estado-gerencial e método histórico-neoestruturalista (1990-atualidade). A hipótese elencada é de que o pensamento cepalino desde 2010 se afastou da proposta de Transformação Produtiva
com Equidade (TPE) – defendido, inicialmente, pelo Neoestruturalismo – e está estabelecendo uma nova concepção: Mudança Estrutural Produtiva para Igualdade (MEPI) A pesquisa optou em priorizar como procedimentos técnicos uma abordagem sistemática por meio da avaliação crítica dos dados bibliográficos e documentais sobre
a temática, sobretudo os próprios documentos produzidos pela CEPAL.

AI.tldr: 本文以联合国拉丁美洲和加勒比经济委员会（CEPAL）为分析单位，研究其当前强调平等的发展思想阶段，将CEPAL思想划分为两个阶段：国家企业家/历史结构主义阶段（1948-1990）和国家管理/历史新结构主义阶段（1990至今），并提出假设：自2010年以来，CEPAL思想已偏离了最初由新结构主义倡导的"具有平等的生产转型"（TPE），正在建立一种新概念——"促进平等的生产结构变革"（MEPI）。
AI.research_question: CEPAL当前阶段的思想是否已经从"具有平等的生产转型"（TPE）转向"促进平等的生产结构变革"（MEPI）？这一新概念的内涵及其与先前理论的差异是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解CEPAL思想在2010年之后的演变，特别是其平等理念从新结构主义的TPE框架向新的MEPI框架的转变，以揭示拉丁美洲发展理论的当代演进。
AI.theoretical_framework: CEPAL的发展思想阶段理论：第一阶段（1948-1990）的历史结构主义与国家企业家角色；第二阶段（1990至今）的历史新结构主义与国家管理角色；以及新提出的MEPI概念对于TPE的替代。
AI.method: 系统性文献评估方法，对CEPAL发布的书目和文献资料进行批判性分析，尤其聚焦于其自身产生的官方文件。
AI.findings: 自2010年以来，CEPAL的思想从新结构主义最初倡导的"具有平等的生产转型"（TPE）转向了"促进平等的生产结构变革"（MEPI），标志着发展理念的又一次范式调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了CEPAL思想的两阶段划分框架（国家企业家/历史结构主义 vs. 国家管理/历史新结构主义），并识别出2010年后从TPE到MEPI的新近理论转变，丰富了发展经济学和拉丁美洲结构主义理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解联合国拉美经委会当前政策建议的核心理念提供了分析基础，有助于拉美国家政府及国际发展机构把握CEPAL最新的政策导向和理论依据。

title: ENERGY EQUITY IN NIGERIA: FROM POLICY TO A JUST AND SUSTAINABLE FUTURE
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: ENERGY EQUITY IN NIGERIA: FROM POLICY TO A JUST AND SUSTAINABLE FUTURE
detail.abstract: Energy is a fundamental pillar of modern life, inextricably linked to economic development, social well-being, and human dignity. However, access to reliable, affordable, and clean energy remains profoundly unequal across the globe and particularly within Nigeria. This paper examines the persistent challenge of energy equity and access in Nigeria, where energy poverty continues to hinder socioeconomic development and environmental sustainability. The study identifies the systemic barriers including inadequate infrastructure, poor policy implementation, financial constraints, and low awareness that limit access to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. Utilizing a mixed-methods approach, the study combines qualitative insights from document analysis with quantitative data from a structured survey of 47 respondents. Key findings indicate that 76.6% of respondents cite high financial costs as the most significant barrier, followed by poor infrastructure and limited energy providers. Additionally, 87.2% believe that policy interventions could meaningfully improve energy access and renewable energy uptake. The results underscore the positive correlation between renewable energy consumption and industrial output, while also revealing disparities in energy access between urban and rural populations. The study highlights the importance of inclusive policies, targeted investment in clean energy infrastructure, and enhanced public awareness to address energy inequities. Ultimately, this research contributes valuable insights for policymakers, energy stakeholders, and development organizations aiming to achieve energy justice and accelerate Nigeria's transition to a more equitable and sustainable energy future

AI.tldr: 本文研究了尼日利亚能源公平与获取的持续挑战，发现76.6%的受访者认为高财务成本是最大障碍，87.2%认为政策干预能改善能源获取。研究强调包容性政策、清洁能源基础设施投资和公众意识提升对解决能源不平等的重要性。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚能源公平与获取面临的系统性障碍是什么？如何通过政策干预和可再生能源推广来解决能源贫困问题？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内（尤其是尼日利亚）能源获取存在严重不平等，能源贫困持续阻碍社会经济发展和环境可持续性，亟需识别系统性障碍并寻找解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源公平理论、能源正义理论、能源贫困理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：结合文档分析的定性洞察与结构化调查（47名受访者）的定量数据。
AI.findings: 1) 76.6%受访者认为高财务成本是最大障碍；2) 87.2%认为政策干预可改善能源获取和可再生能源采用；3) 可再生能源消费与工业产出呈正相关；4) 城乡能源获取存在明显差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 为能源公平与正义理论提供了尼日利亚的实证证据，揭示了发展中国家能源贫困的多维系统性障碍。

title: CHINA-AFRICA RELATIONS IN POLITICAL ECONOMY OF THE WORLD-SYSTEM: IN BETWEEN EXCLUDING-INSERTION AND INCLUDING-INSERTION

detail.title: CHINA-AFRICA RELATIONS IN POLITICAL ECONOMY OF THE WORLD-SYSTEM: IN BETWEEN EXCLUDING-INSERTION AND INCLUDING-INSERTION
detail.abstract: The purpose of this article is to investigate how the current China-Africa relations integrate the Political Economy of the World-System. The paper starts by explaining the theoretical framework of the research, the World-systems theory. Upon examination of the current economic and trade relationship between China and Africa, the research assessed two different models that the underdeveloped economies integrate the international economy: the excluding-insertion and the including-insertion. The article used the descriptivequalitative methodology, using primary and secondary sources. The results indicate that China, when dealing with Africa, is reproducing exploitative power behaviour, the same way all nations are or have been part of the "leader circle" of the world-system have done previously.

AI.tldr: 本文运用世界体系理论，探讨当前中非关系如何融入世界体系的政治经济学。研究发现，中国在非洲复制了以往世界体系"领导圈"国家的剥削性权力行为，通过"排斥性插入"模式将非洲纳入国际经济体系。
AI.research_question: 当前中非关系如何融入世界体系的政治经济学？
AI.motivation: 探究中国在与非洲交往中是否延续了世界体系中核心国家对边缘国家的剥削性行为模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世界体系理论（World-systems theory），以及"排斥性插入"（excluding-insertion）与"包容性插入"（including-insertion）两种不发达经济体融入国际经济的模型。
AI.method: 描述性定性方法（descriptive-qualitative methodology），使用一手和二手资料。
AI.findings: 中国在与非洲打交道时，正在复制以往世界体系"领导圈"国家的剥削性权力行为，即通过"排斥性插入"模式将非洲纳入全球经济体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将世界体系理论应用于分析当代中非关系，揭示了新兴大国（中国）在全球体系中可能延续旧有剥削模式的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和学界重新审视中非合作的本质，关注中国在非洲的经济行为是否真正有利于非洲的自主发展，而非延续不平等关系。

title: Collaboration in the Australian Quantum Ecosystem: Opportunities and Challenges for Research Security Regulatory Frameworks in Australia
affiliations: University of Technology Sydney, Faculty of Law and University of New South Wales (UNSW) - UNSW Law & Justice

detail.title: Collaboration in the Australian Quantum Ecosystem: Opportunities and Challenges for Research Security Regulatory Frameworks in Australia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Dr Susanne Lloyd-Jones received an Australian Academy of Law 2025 Research Grant to undertake the research contained in the report.
declarations.funderStatement: The research was funded by an Australian Academy of Law 2025 Research Grant.

contentType.other: Research report funded and published by the Australian Academy of Law

detail.abstract: This report draws on research funded by an Australian Academy of Law Research Grant 2025. It is a scoping analysis of collaboration in the Australian quantum ecosystem that was undertaken in the context of the 2025 Strategic Examination of Research and Development (SERD) and the 2024 reforms of the Defence Trade Controls Act 2012 (Cth) (DTCA). The research finds that in research and development contexts the concept of collaboration is repeatedly used. It frequently frames discussions and drives research priorities. Yet, the concept of collaboration is regularly left undefined. Collaboration is integral to research and innovation for new and emerging technologies. Leaving collaboration undefined, especially when communicating about research security frameworks, risks causing confusion and misunderstandings about the nature of scientific research, who may work with whom, and when collaboration might drift into criminal conduct under Australia’s export control regime and foreign interference laws. The research also identifies potential blockers and enablers of collaboration as expressed by a subset of submitters who made submissions to both the SERD and DTCA reviews. The research will be used to inform future work on the theoretical and practical definitions of collaboration and to enquire into how evolving national and international research security frameworks might block and enable effective collaboration in the Australian quantum ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了澳大利亚量子生态系统中的"协作"概念，发现该概念在研发语境中被频繁使用但鲜有明确定义，尤其在研究安全框架下可能引发误解和法律风险，并识别了协作的促进因素与阻碍因素。
AI.research_question: 在澳大利亚量子生态系统中，"协作"概念是如何被使用的？缺乏明确定义会带来什么风险？哪些因素会促进或阻碍协作？
AI.motivation: "协作"在研发政策讨论中被反复提及并驱动研究优先级，但其内涵从未被清晰界定。在出口管制和外国干涉法律框架下，定义模糊可能导致科研人员误入刑事违法领域，亟需厘清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念分析（概念的定义与使用）、研究安全框架（国防贸易管制、外国干涉法律）、生态系统协作理论（促进因素与阻碍因素）。
AI.method: 范围界定分析（scoping analysis），基于对2025年SERD和2024年DTCA改革中提交意见的子集进行分析。
AI.findings: "协作"概念在研发语境中被反复使用并主导政策讨论，但始终缺乏明确定义；这种模糊性在研究安全沟通中可能导致对科研性质、合作对象及法律边界的误解；识别了部分提交者所表达的协作促进因素与阻碍因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"协作"这一核心概念在量子生态系统政策话语中的定义空白，为后续概念定义的理论研究奠定基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为澳大利亚量子生态系统中的政策制定者和研究人员提供了关于协作定义模糊性所带来法律风险的警示，并识别了实践中的协作促进与阻碍因素，以指导未来研究安全框架的设计。

title: Directional Decoupling and the Volatility-Ratio Channel: A Beta-Decomposition Framework for Exchange-Native Tokens — Evidence from the BNB-ETH Relationship, 2022-2026
affiliations: Betalabs Inc

detail.title: Directional Decoupling and the Volatility-Ratio Channel: A Beta-Decomposition Framework for Exchange-Native Tokens — Evidence from the BNB-ETH Relationship, 2022-2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Standard factor models in cryptocurrency asset pricing [Liu & Tsyvinski, 2021; Liu et al., 2024] treat beta as a sufficient statistic for systematic exposure. The identity β = ρ · (σᵢ / σₘ) implies, however, that beta can change for two distinct reasons: a change in directional co-movement (the correlation channel) or a change in relative volatility (the volatility-ratio channel). The economic interpretations differ sharply, but the existing literature does not systematically separate them.

This paper proposes a variance-decomposition framework that isolates these two channels and applies it to a striking empirical pattern in cryptocurrency markets that we term directional decoupling: a decline in beta accompanied by an unchanged correlation. Using daily price data from Coin Metrics covering May 2022 to April 2026 (n = 1,460 trading days), we document that BNB’s static beta to ETH declines by 16.9% (from 0.643 to 0.534), while the Pearson correlation remains essentially unchanged (0.731 → 0.731).

The decomposition reveals that 100% of the static beta change is attributable to a decline in the volatility ratio σ_BNB / σ_ETH (from 0.879 to 0.730), with no contribution from correlation change. A further numerator/denominator decomposition shows that BNB-side volatility compression accounts for approximately 57% of the ratio decline, while ETH-side volatility expansion accounts for approximately 43%, indicating that the apparent BNB pattern is jointly produced by BNB-specific and ETH-side dynamics. Robert F. Engle’s DCC-GARCH framework [Engle, 2002] confirms the qualitative pattern under dynamic conditional moments: dynamic correlation rises (0.698 → 0.747, p < 0.001), while dynamic beta declines (0.575 → 0.541, −5.84%).

Cross-sectional analysis of 16 altcoins—including exchange tokens, Layer-1 platforms, DeFi/oracle tokens, and other major altcoins—reveals substantial heterogeneity in beta dynamics across and within categories, with BNB occupying the moderate-to-strong decoupling segment but not an extreme position (BNB rank 6/17 in the cross-sectional pool, t = −2.22, p = 0.043 against the control mean; synthetic-control rank 12/17, p ≈ 0.71). The cross-sectional evidence supports interpreting BNB’s pattern as part of a broader altcoin beta recompression coinciding with ETH’s post-2024 volatility expansion, rather than as an asset-specific regime change.

We discuss implications for cryptocurrency factor models, arguing that beta-based models should be augmented with explicit decomposition into correlation and volatility-ratio components when interpreting changes in systematic exposure. We also identify on-chain stablecoin flow data and staggered-treatment designs around individual exchange holder-reward launches as priority directions for follow-up causal-mechanism studies. The April 2024 launch of the Binance HODLer Airdrops program serves as a natural timing benchmark for partitioning the sample but is not the basis for any causal claim in this paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个方差分解框架，将加密货币资产定价中的beta变化分解为相关性通道和波动率比率通道。通过对BNB的实证分析（2022年5月至2026年4月），发现BNB的静态beta下降16.9%完全由波动率比率下降驱动（BNB侧压缩占57%，ETH侧扩张占43%），而相关性几乎不变。横截面分析表明这是更广泛的altcoin beta再压缩现象的一部分，而非资产特异性事件。论文呼吁beta因子模型应纳入显式分解。
AI.research_question: 加密货币资产定价中，beta的变化究竟是由方向性共运动（相关性通道）还是相对波动率（波动率比率通道）驱动的？如何系统地将这两个通道分离？
AI.motivation: 标准因子模型将beta视为系统性暴露的充分统计量，但beta = ρ·(σᵢ/σₘ)的恒等式意味着beta变化有两种截然不同的经济含义。现有文献未能系统区分这两种通道，而这对于理解资产风险特征变化、构建因子模型和投资决策具有重要经济意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 方差分解框架：将beta变化拆解为相关性通道和波动率比率通道。2. 分子/分母分解：进一步将波动率比率变化分解为资产侧和基准侧贡献。3. DCC-GARCH动态条件矩验证（Engle, 2002）。4. 横截面合成控制分析。
AI.method: 1. 方差分解框架：基于beta = ρ·(σᵢ/σₘ)的恒等式，通过对数差分或算术分解分离两个通道。2. 实证数据：Coin Metrics日度价格数据，2022年5月至2026年4月（n=1,460个交易日）。3. DCC-GARCH（Engle, 2002）验证动态条件矩下的模式。4. 横截面分析：16种altcoin，包括交易所代币、Layer-1平台、DeFi/预言机代币等，使用合成控制方法检验BNB是否处于极端位置。
AI.findings: 1. BNB的静态beta下降16.9%（0.643→0.534），而Pearson相关性几乎不变（0.731→0.731）。2. 方差分解显示100%的beta变化由波动率比率下降驱动（0.879→0.730），相关性贡献为零。3. 分子/分母分解：BNB侧波动率压缩占57%，ETH侧波动率扩张占43%。4. DCC-GARCH确认：动态相关性上升（0.698→0.747, p<0.001），动态beta下降（0.575→0.541, -5.84%）。5. 横截面分析：16种altcoin呈现出显著的异质性，BNB处于中等偏强的解耦区间但非极端（排名6/17, t=-2.22, p=0.043；合成控制排名12/17, p≈0.71）。这表明该模式是更广泛的altcoin beta再压缩现象的一部分，与ETH在2024年后的波动率扩张同时发生。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统地将beta变化分解为相关性通道和波动率比率通道，为加密货币资产定价提供了新的分析框架。2. 揭示了"方向性解耦"现象：beta下降而相关性不变，挑战了将beta简单等同于系统性暴露的传统认知。3. 提出了beta因子模型应增强显式分解的建议，为改进加密货币因子模型提供了理论方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者和风险管理人提供了更精细化的beta分解工具，有助于识别风险变化的真实来源（是共运动改变还是波动率结构改变）。2. 对加密货币交易所、协议和项目方而言，理解波动率比率通道有助于设计更有效的激励政策和风险管理策略。3. 指出了链上稳定币流动数据和交错处理设计作为后续因果机制研究的方向，为实证研究提供了路线图。

title: Gauge-Equivariant Neural Operators for Yang-Mills and Gauge-Covariant PDEs
affiliations: and

detail.title: Gauge-Equivariant Neural Operators for Yang-Mills and Gauge-Covariant PDEs

declarations.funderStatement: Funded by a university wide grant. Sehyeok Park and Rajit Chatterjea both contributed equally to this project

detail.abstract: We propose a mathematical framework for gauge-equivariant neural operators (GENOs), a class of neural operators that exactly preserve gauge symmetry at the operator level. Existing neural operator architectures such as DeepONet and the Fourier Neural Operator approximate mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces but do not preserve the geometric symmetries intrinsic to gauge theories. Consequently, learned operators may violate gauge covariance, fail to preserve orbit structure under gauge transformations, and produce nonphysical dynamics. We develop a rigorous functional-analytic theory for neural operators acting on Sobolev spaces of gauge connections and sections of associated vector bundles. We characterize gauge-equivariant operator architectures satisfying exact covariance under the action of infinite-dimensional gauge groups. Our framework applies to Yang-Mills flow, Maxwell equations, nonlinear Schrödinger systems with gauge symmetry, and geometric PDEs arising in mathematical physics. The principal contributions are as follows. First, we define gauge-equivariant neural operators on Sobolev spaces of connections and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for exact gauge covariance. Second, we construct architecture classes built from gauge-covariant integral kernels using parallel transport and prove closure under composition. Third, we establish universal approximation theorems for gauge-equivariant operators, leveraging a symmetrization procedure via invariant averages over finitedimensional approximations to the gauge group. Fourth, we derive approximation-rate parity results showing that gauge-equivariant constraints impose no asymptotic approximation penalty relative to unconstrained neural operators. Fifth, we analyze the interaction between gauge fixing and equivariant architectures. Finally, we establish residual-to-error estimates for gauge-covariant PDE solution operators and apply these to Yang-Mills flow, Maxwell theory, and magnetic Schrödinger equations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种规范等变神经算子（GENO）的数学框架，该算子能够在算子层面精确保持规范对称性，解决了现有神经算子架构无法保持规范理论中几何对称性的问题。作者构建了作用在规范联络和相伴向量丛截面Sobolev空间上的规范等变算子架构，证明了精确协变性条件，并建立了通用逼近定理和逼近率平价结果，最后将框架应用于Yang-Mills流、Maxwell方程和磁Schrödinger方程等几何PDE问题。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种在算子层面上精确保持规范对称性的神经算子架构（规范等变神经算子，GENO）？
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子（如DeepONet、FNO）能够逼近无限维函数空间之间的映射，但无法保持规范理论中固有的几何对称性，导致学习到的算子可能违反规范协变性、无法保持规范变换下的轨道结构，并产生非物理动力学。因此需要开发一种具有内在规范对称性的神经算子架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泛函分析（Sobolev空间、无限维规范群作用）、规范理论（规范联络、相伴向量丛、平行输运）、等变神经网络理论、通用逼近理论。
AI.method: （1）在联络的Sobolev空间上定义规范等变神经算子，建立精确规范协变性的充要条件；（2）利用平行输运构建基于规范协变积分核的架构类，证明其复合封闭性；（3）通过对规范群的有限维近似进行不变平均的对称化过程，建立通用逼近定理；（4）推导逼近率平价结果；（5）分析规范固定与等变架构的相互作用；（6）建立规范协变PDE解算子的残差-误差估计。
AI.findings: （1）成功构建了精确保持规范对称性的神经算子架构；（2）证明了规范等变约束不会带来渐近逼近代价（逼近率平价）；（3）所提框架可有效应用于Yang-Mills流、Maxwell方程和磁Schrödinger方程等规范理论中的几何PDE问题。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将神经算子推广到规范等变设置，建立了严格的泛函分析理论基础；（2）给出了精确规范协变性的充要条件；（3）证明了规范等变神经算子的通用逼近定理；（4）证明了逼近率平价结果，表明对称性约束不影响逼近效率。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为物理模拟、规范场论计算等提供了保持物理对称性的深度学习架构；（2）可用于Yang-Mills流、Maxwell方程、磁Schrödinger方程等几何PDE的数值求解；（3）为规范理论中的机器学习应用提供了理论保障。

title: Beyond E-Commerce: IoT infrastructure, Data Access, Privacy, and Platform Boundaries
affiliations: , Faculty of Business in SciTech, University of Science and Technology of China, University of Texas at Dallas, Naveen Jindal School of Management and University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management

detail.title: Beyond E-Commerce: IoT infrastructure, Data Access, Privacy, and Platform Boundaries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: Digital platforms are increasingly expanding beyond transaction intermediation to provide technological infrastructure within their ecosystems. In markets for smart consumer devices, a platform may offer Internet-of-Things (IoT) infrastructure that connects devices to cloud services and generates device-level data. This raises a central question: when should a marketplace platform vertically expand to provide IoT infrastructure to a manufacturer? We develop a model in which a manufacturer sells smart devices on a platform. The platform can obtain algorithmic learning benefits from data generated by connected devices directly by providing IoT infrastructure. Alternatively, the platform can acquire data indirectly through external data markets. While infrastructure provision gives the platform direct access to device-level data and a pricing instrument to influence device adoption, it also introduces consumer privacy costs that may reduce demand. We show that the platform has an incentive to provide IoT infrastructure when the value of data-driven learning is sufficiently high, even without a cost advantage in infrastructure provision. Consumer privacy concerns have a non-monotonic effect on platform IoT provision: moderate privacy concerns discourage provisioning, whereas high privacy concerns may increase it by eliminating external data markets as an alternative source of data acquisition. The platform may also optimally subsidize manufacturers’ IoT adoption to expand device deployment and data generation. Finally, restricting platform access to infrastructure-generated data can reduce consumer surplus and manufacturer profit in regions where platform-provisioned IoT would otherwise arise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数字平台何时应垂直扩张，为制造商提供物联网基础设施以获取设备级数据。研究发现，当数据驱动学习价值足够高时，平台有动机提供物联网基础设施，即使没有成本优势。隐私关注对物联网提供具有非单调影响，适度隐私关注抑制供给，高隐私关注反而可能促进供给。平台还可能补贴制造商的物联网采用，而限制平台访问基础设施生成的数据可能损害消费者剩余和制造商利润。
AI.research_question: 当市场平台何时应该垂直扩张，为制造商提供物联网基础设施？
AI.motivation: 数字平台正从交易中介扩展到提供生态系统内的技术基础设施，在智能消费设备市场中，平台可提供连接设备与云服务的物联网基础设施并生成设备级数据，这引发平台是否应垂直扩张的关键问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台经济理论、数据驱动的算法学习理论、隐私成本理论、垂直整合与市场扩张理论
AI.method: 数学模型构建与分析，通过建立制造商在平台销售智能设备的博弈模型，考察平台通过提供物联网基础设施直接获取数据与通过外部数据市场间接获取数据的权衡。
AI.findings: 1) 当数据驱动学习价值足够高时，平台有动机提供物联网基础设施，即使没有成本优势；2) 消费者隐私关注对平台物联网供给具有非单调影响——适度隐私关注抑制供给，高隐私关注反而可能消除外部数据市场这一替代渠道，从而促进供给；3) 平台可能补贴制造商的物联网采用以扩大设备部署和数据生成；4) 限制平台访问基础设施生成的数据，在平台本应提供物联网的区域会降低消费者剩余和制造商利润。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了平台垂直扩张至物联网基础设施提供的新动机（数据驱动的算法学习），发现了隐私关注对平台基础设施投资策略的非单调影响机制，分析了数据获取渠道（内部vs外部）的替代关系对平台战略的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台企业是否及如何投资物联网基础设施提供决策指导，为政策制定者监管平台数据访问权限提供理论依据，提醒限制平台数据访问可能意外损害消费者和制造商福利。

title: Demand Cultivation: A Social Function for Surfacing Non-Market Value

detail.title: Demand Cultivation: A Social Function for Surfacing Non-Market Value

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Trans V LLC and leads the design and operation of Shinketsu DAO, which is presented in this paper as one implementation case of the Demand Cultivation framework. The author has not received any external funding or commercial sponsorship for this research, and the views expressed are the author's own.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical and design-oriented paper that does not involve human subjects, patient data, or empirical research requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency. The research was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Modern economies face a paradox: while supply of physical goods and services has reached unprecedented saturation, what people experience as scarce has shifted to forms of value that markets struggle to express-trust, context, empathy, narrative, attentional time, and the directional question of "whom do we want to support." These values lack the language and infrastructure to be expressed as demand, leaving them structurally underserved. This paper defines Demand Cultivation as a social mechanism that structures pre-supply demand through economic commitment, temporal maturation, and bidirectional reward. Existing mechanisms-crowdfunding, Patreon-style continuous support, prediction markets, pre-orders, and wishlists-each assume that supply (or its concrete proposal) precedes demand expression. Demand Cultivation breaks this assumption: it allows demand to be structured independently, in advance of any specific supplier, and rewards both demand expressers and eventual suppliers for their contributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"需求培育"（Demand Cultivation）作为一种独立于供给、可提前结构化表达需求的社会机制，解决现代经济中信任、共情、叙事等价值因缺乏需求表达基础设施而未被市场充分服务的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种社会机制，使那些难以通过传统市场信号表达的"稀缺价值"（如信任、共情、叙事、注意力时间等）能够被结构化为有效的需求？
AI.motivation: 现代经济中物质供给空前饱和，但信任、共情、叙事等价值却日益稀缺；现有市场机制无法为这些价值提供需求表达的语言和基础设施，导致它们被结构性忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求培育（Demand Cultivation）——一种通过经济承诺、时间成熟和双向奖励来结构化供给前需求的社会机制。与现有机制（众筹、Patreon、预测市场、预购、愿望清单）的核心区别在于，需求表达可独立于具体供给方先行结构化。
AI.method: 概念性理论建构：通过比较分析现有机制（众筹、持续性支持平台、预测市场、预购、愿望清单），界定"需求培育"的核心特征与运作逻辑。
AI.findings: 现有需求表达机制均假设供给（或具体供给提案）先于需求表达；"需求培育"突破了这一假设，允许需求在无具体供给方的情况下先行结构化，并对需求表达者和最终供给者均给予奖励。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"需求培育"这一新型社会机制概念，挑战了传统经济中"供给先于需求"的基本假设，拓展了对市场价值表达形式的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信任、共情、叙事等被市场忽视的价值提供了可操作的需求结构化路径，可能催生新的平台设计和经济制度创新。

title: Correctness SLAs: Defining Measurable Guarantees for Business Logic Accuracy in Enterprise Systems

detail.title: Correctness SLAs: Defining Measurable Guarantees for Business Logic Accuracy in Enterprise Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research was conducted independently and without any personal, financial, or organizational influences that could have affected the outcomes of the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Enterprise systems are governed by a well-established and universally adopted framework of Service Level Agreements (SLAs) defining measurable guarantees for service availability-uptime percentages, response latency, error rate thresholds, and throughput targets. These availability SLAs have matured into operational standards that drive monitoring infrastructure, incident response processes, and vendor contracts across the global technology industry. Yet a structurally equivalent governance framework for the correctness of business logic-the accuracy of the outcomes that available services produce-does not exist. A service can achieve 99.99% availability while producing incorrect transaction outcomes, misapplied business rules, inconsistent cross-service state, and erroneous financial calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，企业系统普遍采用服务水平协议（SLA）来衡量服务的可用性（如正常运行时间、响应延迟等），但缺乏一个结构等效的治理框架来确保业务逻辑的正确性——即服务可用时产生的业务结果是否准确。一个服务可能达到99.99%的可用性，但仍可能产生错误的交易结果、误用的业务规则、不一致的跨服务状态和错误的财务计算。
AI.research_question: 为什么企业系统缺乏一个类似于可用性SLA的、用于保障业务逻辑正确性的治理框架？
AI.motivation: 现有SLA框架仅关注服务可用性指标，忽视了业务逻辑正确性这一关键维度，导致高可用性服务仍可能产生严重的业务错误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 服务水平协议（SLA）框架；业务逻辑正确性治理理论
AI.method: 概念性分析/问题提出，基于对现有SLA框架的批判性审视。
AI.findings: 存在一个结构性缺口：可用性SLA已成熟并被广泛采用，但没有与之对等的业务逻辑正确性治理框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业系统治理中的一个理论空白，即可用性与正确性之间的治理不对称性。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁业界构建类似于可用性SLA的业务逻辑正确性治理框架，以避免高可用性服务下隐藏的重大业务风险。

title: Securing Autonomous AI Agents: A Reference Architecture for Data Protection in the Agentic AI Era
affiliations: and OWOW Talents Inc

detail.title: Securing Autonomous AI Agents: A Reference Architecture for Data Protection in the Agentic AI Era
detail.abstract: Problem. Agentic Artificial Intelligence (autonomous systems with persistent memory, multi-step reasoning, and real-world tool invocation) has redefined the data-protection threat surface. Unlike stateless Large Language Models, agentic systems independently access, transform, and can exfiltrate data across distributed infrastructures, exposing novel risks from prompt injection, memory poisoning, tool misuse, shadow-agent emergence, and cross-layer threat propagation. Approach. This paper develops a cross-layer reference architecture for secure autonomous data protection by synthesizing recent agent-specific contributions with foundational protection literature. Architecture. Five integrated layers are proposed: cryptographic identity and delegation; sandboxed execution; policy enforcement and data mediation; observability and audit; and lifecycle governance. Each layer is anchored to specific provisions of the EU AI Act and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and is mapped to representative research including SAGA (Syros et al., 2025), the Caging the Agents healthcare deployment (Maiti, 2026), TRiSM (Raza et al., 2026), and enterprise designs (Bokka, 2025; Kolli et al., 2024). Findings. The paper identifies persistent gaps in memory integrity, federated revocation, post-quantum identity, and benchmarking under non-deterministic execution, and offers a forward-looking research agenda for trustworthy, accountable, and privacy-preserving agentic deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自主式人工智能(Agentic AI)带来的新型数据保护威胁，提出了一种跨层参考架构，涵盖密码身份与委托、沙箱执行、策略执行与数据中介、可观测性与审计、生命周期治理五个层面，并将其映射至欧盟AI法案、NIST AI风险管理框架及多项前沿研究，最后识别出记忆完整性、联邦撤销、后量子身份及非确定性执行基准测试等关键研究空白。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够应对Agentic AI系统特有数据保护威胁（如提示注入、内存投毒、工具滥用、影子代理涌现及跨层威胁传播）的安全架构？
AI.motivation: Agentic AI（具有持久记忆、多步推理和真实世界工具调用的自主系统）已重新定义数据保护威胁面，其与无状态大语言模型不同，能够独立访问、转换和泄露跨分布式基础设施的数据，暴露了传统安全方法无法应对的新型风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨层参考架构，整合密码学、沙箱执行、策略引擎、可观测性与生命周期治理等理论基础，并锚定于欧盟AI法案和NIST AI风险管理框架。
AI.method: 综合近期Agent特定安全贡献与基础保护文献，进行跨层架构设计与映射分析。
AI.findings: (1) 提出五层安全架构：密码身份与委托、沙箱执行、策略执行与数据中介、可观测性与审计、生命周期治理；(2) 各层映射至欧盟AI法案、NIST AI风险管理框架及代表性研究；(3) 识别出记忆完整性、联邦撤销、后量子身份、非确定性执行基准测试等持续存在的空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将Agentic AI特有安全威胁与合规框架（EU AI Act、NIST AI RMF）进行结构化映射，并提出跨层参考架构，填补了自主AI系统数据保护理论框架的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可信、可问责、隐私保护的Agentic AI部署提供了可操作的五层架构指南，明确了关键研究空白与未来研究方向，有助于指导企业级安全设计与监管合规。

title: Architectural Options for Transactional Reporting

detail.title: Architectural Options for Transactional Reporting
detail.abstract: Almost every transactional information system eventually becomes a source for reporting and analytics. Yet the architectural decision of how to deliver that reporting is frequently made implicitly, leading to over-engineered pipelines for simple use cases or, conversely, fragile reporting layers that strain the operational database. This paper surveys six widely used architectural options for delivering reporting on top of an Online Transaction Processing (OLTP) system: (i) using the transactional database directly; (ii) augmenting it with embedded reporting tables; (iii) native database replication with adjoint reporting tables; (iv) Change Data Capture (CDC) replication into a reimagined reporting schema; (v) ingestion into an Elasticsearch / ELK cluster; and (vi) ingestion into a Delta Lake / lakehouse. For each option we describe the architecture, characterize the trade-offs in performance isolation, schema flexibility, total cost of ownership, and time-to-market, and provide indicative effort and cost ranges based on practitioner experience. We then synthesize these into a decision framework that maps reporting requirements (data shape, latency, scale, audience, integration breadth) to the most cost-effective option. The intent is to give engineering managers and architects a vocabulary and a structured way to reason about reporting architecture before reaching for the most expensive default.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了在OLTP事务系统之上实现报表分析的六种架构方案，并提供了基于报表需求特征的成本效益决策框架，帮助工程管理者避免过度工程化或架构选择错误。
AI.research_question: 如何根据报表需求特征，在OLTP系统之上选择最合适的报表交付架构？
AI.motivation: 报表架构决策常被隐式做出，导致简单场景过度工程化或复杂场景架构脆弱，缺乏结构化的决策指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 报表架构决策框架，基于性能隔离、Schema灵活性、总拥有成本（TCO）、上市时间等维度进行六种架构的权衡分析。
AI.method: 对六种常见报表架构进行系统性调研与比较分析，基于从业者经验提供努力程度和成本范围，并综合为决策框架。
AI.findings: 六种架构在性能隔离、Schema灵活性、TCO和上市时间上存在显著差异；决策框架可根据数据形态、延迟要求、规模、受众和集成广度等需求特征映射到最优方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了结构化的报表架构分类与权衡分析框架，填补了实务中报表架构选择缺乏系统性指导的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工程管理者和架构师提供了一套通用术语和决策流程，帮助在投入最昂贵的默认方案之前理性评估架构选项，降低成本和风险。

title: Foundations of AI Security: Historical Evolution and Contemporary Threat Landscape

detail.title: Foundations of AI Security: Historical Evolution and Contemporary Threat Landscape

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares the following potential interests. Rizwan Tanveer is employed as Principal Consultant at DTS Solution (Beyon Cyber), a cybersecurity consultancy operating in the Gulf Cooperation Council region, and serves as Executive Consultant at DPO Europe. The frameworks and standards discussed in this paper, including NIST AI 100-2, the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, the Cloud Security Alliance MAESTRO framework, and ISO/IEC 42001, are publicly available reference materials, and neither DTS Solution nor DPO Europe holds a financial interest in any specific framework or vendor referenced. This paper is a narrative literature review based on publicly available primary sources, including standards documents, regulatory guidance, and peer-reviewed academic literature. No human participants, patient data, or animal subjects were involved in the research.

keywords: L86 ACM CCS: Security and privacy ~ Software and application security
Security and privacy ~ Human and societal aspects of security and privacy ~ Governance

detail.abstract:
Background. Artificial intelligence security has evolved from a peripheral concern within machine learning research into a central discipline of contemporary cybersecurity practice. The shift from static predictive models to autonomous agentic systems has introduced threat surfaces that legacy security frameworks were not designed to address, creating a widening gap between operational AI deployment and defensible security assurance.

Purpose. This article traces the conceptual and technical evolution of AI security from early adversarial machine learning research to the contemporary threat landscape of 2026, examines the structural inadequacies of traditional cybersecurity frameworks when applied to AI systems, and positions emerging frameworks as essential instruments for practitioner-led AI security engineering.

Approach. The article is structured as a narrative literature review drawing on authoritative primary sources, including NIST AI 100-2 E2025, NIST AI 600-1, the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (December 2025), the Cloud Security Alliance MAESTRO framework, MITRE ATLAS, and foundational adversarial machine learning literature spanning 2013 to 2025. Sources were selected for authority, currency, and direct relevance to operational AI security practice.

Findings. Three structural shifts characterise the contemporary landscape: the expansion of attack surfaces from model parameters to data pipelines and agent ecosystems; the inadequacy of deterministic threat modelling frameworks for non-deterministic, learning systems; and the emergence of identity-centric and orchestration-centric security as the dominant paradigm for agentic AI.

Implications. Practitioners require a layered framework approach, combining traditional cybersecurity controls with AI-specific governance instruments. The article provides a comparative basis for selecting and integrating these frameworks within enterprise security programmes.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了AI安全从早期对抗性机器学习到2026年威胁格局的演变，指出现有安全框架无法应对自主代理系统的非确定性威胁，并提出需将传统网络安全控制与AI特定治理工具相结合的层级框架方案。
AI.research_question: AI安全如何从对抗性机器学习演进为当代网络安全核心学科？传统网络安全框架为何不适用于AI系统？新兴框架如何支撑从业者的AI安全工程实践？
AI.motivation: 从静态预测模型向自主代理系统的转变引入了传统安全框架无法应对的新威胁面，造成AI运营部署与安全保证之间的差距日益扩大，亟需对AI安全演进进行系统梳理并探索适用的框架方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对抗性机器学习理论；NIST AI 100-2 E2025、NIST AI 600-1等框架；OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications；CSA MAESTRO框架；MITRE ATLAS
AI.method: 叙事性文献综述，选取了NIST、OWASP、CSA、MITRE等权威机构的框架文件及2013-2025年间对抗性机器学习基础文献。
AI.findings: 三个结构性转变：1）攻击面从模型参数扩展到数据管道和代理生态系统；2）确定性威胁建模框架无法应对非确定性学习系统；3）身份中心化与编排中心化安全成为代理AI的主导范式。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了AI安全从对抗性机器学习到代理系统安全的完整演进脉络，揭示了传统确定性框架与AI非确定性系统之间的结构性不兼容。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了将传统网络安全控制与AI特定治理工具相结合的层级框架选择与整合的比较基础，指导企业安全项目的框架选型。

title: Agentic Climate Intelligence: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Human-Centered Climate-Resilient Smart Cities
affiliations: Hellenic Open University, Hellenic Open University and University of Piraeus

detail.title: Agentic Climate Intelligence: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Human-Centered Climate-Resilient Smart Cities
detail.abstract: Climate-related hazards increasingly affect the resilience of contemporary cities, particularly through extreme heat, flooding, and infrastructure stress. Existing smart city platforms have improved urban monitoring by integrating Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures, edge computing, and datadriven analytics. However, they still rely largely on centralized or weakly hierarchical decision architectures, which may struggle to provide timely and adaptive responses under dynamic and spatially heterogeneous conditions. In this paper, we introduce Agentic Climate Intelligence (ACI), a human-centered multiagent architecture for climate-resilient smart cities. We model urban climate intelligence as a distributed cyber-physical system operating across an edge-cloud continuum, where specialized agents perform sensing, forecasting, risk assessment, coordination, and adaptation. The proposed architecture combines realtime urban sensing, digital twin simulation, federated learning, and human-in-the-loop oversight to support accountable and context-aware decision-making. We define a formal agent model and present a layered system design, together with coordination mechanisms based on event-driven communication, weighted consensus, and contract-net style resource allocation. We illustrate the approach through an urban heat risk management scenario, using a reproducible evaluation setup based on historical replay and digital twin simulation. The results suggest that decentralized agent-based coordination may improve responsiveness and system stability compared to conventional smart city approaches, although performance appears to depend on environmental variability and communication overhead. Overall, the paper presents a structured architectural perspective on agentic AI for climate resilience and identifies open challenges related to verification, fairness, interoperability, and trusted deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"智能体气候智能(Agentic Climate Intelligence, ACI)"的去中心化多智能体架构，旨在提升气候韧性智慧城市在极端热浪、洪水等灾害中的响应能力。该架构结合物联网感知、数字孪生、联邦学习和人机协同，在边缘-云连续体上运行，并通过事件驱动通信、加权共识和合同网资源分配实现协调。基于城市热风险管理的仿真实验表明，相比于传统集中式智慧城市方法，去中心化的智能体协调能提升响应速度和系统稳定性，但性能受环境变化和通信开销影响。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种去中心化的、以人为本的多智能体架构，以提升智慧城市在动态、空间异质的气候灾害条件下的实时感知、预测、风险评估、协调与适应能力？
AI.motivation: 现有的智慧城市平台虽然集成了物联网、边缘计算和数据驱动分析，但大多依赖集中式或弱分层决策架构，在面对动态、空间异质的气候灾害条件时，难以提供及时和自适应的响应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智能体气候智能(ACI)架构；分布式信息物理系统；多智能体协调机制（事件驱动通信、加权共识、合同网资源分配）；数字孪生仿真；联邦学习；人机协同闭环。
AI.method: 提出ACI正式智能体模型与分层系统设计；通过城市热风险管理场景进行实验评估；采用基于历史回放和数字孪生仿真的可复现评估框架。
AI.findings: 去中心化的智能体协调相比传统智慧城市方法可提升响应速度和系统稳定性，但性能受环境变异性和通信开销的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种针对气候韧性的结构化多智能体架构（ACI），形式化了智能体模型与分层设计，为去中心化气候智能在城市治理中的应用提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候韧性智慧城市的实际系统设计提供了可参考的架构范式和协调机制；提出的评估框架（历史回放+数字孪生）可支持可复现的仿真验证；明确了验证、公平性、互操作性和可信部署等未来开放挑战。

title:
Variance Without Common Standards 
--LLM System Output Under Premise-Stress and the Sharpening of the Maestro Model--
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
Variance Without Common Standards 
--LLM System Output Under Premise-Stress and the Sharpening of the Maestro Model--

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

keywords.keywords: Maestro Model; multi-system review; large language model disposition variance; premise-stress diagnostics; post-training calibration; common standards in artificial intelligence; contextual-deployment judgment; engineering responsibility in artificial intelligence; epistemic transparency; sycophancy; LLM evaluation methodology; human–AI collaboration; intellectual sovereignty; in-product disposition legibility; variance-reporting as output; task-disposition fit.

detail.abstract: This essay reports a controlled diagnostic exercise in which seven leading systems — Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.7, Google Search, Google's Gemini, Microsoft's Copilot, OpenAI's GPT, Perplexity AI Pro, and xAI's SuperGrok — were given an identical multi-part problem statement (reproduced verbatim in Appendix A) that bundled a category error, an empirically false premise, and an underspecified notational request. The seven responses sorted into three stable behavioral modes — corrective, accommodating, and compliant — that predicted performance across the parts of the prompt and that varied more widely than is commonly assumed for systems benchmarking in the upper quartile on standard capability tests. The modes are presented as operational categories inferred from behavior in a diagnostic setting rather than as fixed system properties. The essay analyzes the variance, locates its primary cause at the post-training disposition layer rather than at the capability or corpus layer (Bai et al., 2022; Casper et al., 2023; Christiano et al., 2017; Ouyang et al., 2022), and sharpens the Maestro Model in light of the findings. It develops the resulting argument that engineering responsibility for disposition opacity is currently distributed in ways that disadvantage users without methodological resources to compensate (Bender et al., 2021; Bommasani et al., 2021; Mitchell et al., 2019; Weidinger et al., 2022). The intended audience is the working user who relies on one or two systems without cross-comparison and who therefore carries epistemic, ethical, and practical risks — including in medical decision-making, legal interpretation, educational assessment, and other domains where convincingly delivered wrong answers can cause concrete harm — that may not have been explicitly named. The essay is positioned as a companion to the author's prior work on the Maestro Model, articulated in The Baton and the Symphony (Houze, 2025) and developed in Agency, Tools, and Authorship in the Age of Large Language Models (Houze, 2026a) and The Arc of Human Agency Capture (Houze, 2026b).

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项受控诊断实验，发现七种主流大语言模型（Claude、Gemini、GPT等）在面对含逻辑错误、虚假前提和模糊要求的提示时，表现出纠正型、顺应型和服从型三种稳定行为模式，且差异远超预期。作者指出这种差异源于后训练处置层（post-training disposition layer），并分析了由此带来的用户风险与责任分配问题。
AI.research_question: 不同大语言模型在面对包含范畴谬误、经验性虚假前提和模糊符号要求的多部件问题时，会表现出怎样的行为模式？这些模式的差异有多大，其根源是什么？
AI.motivation: 用户通常依赖少数几个系统且缺乏跨系统比较的能力，而当前基准测试对顶级模型的能力差异估计不足。在医疗决策、法律解释、教育评估等高风险场景中，模型给出的错误答案可能造成实质性伤害，因此有必要揭示模型在诊断性任务中的行为差异及其根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于后训练处置层（post-training disposition layer）理论（Bai et al., 2022; Casper et al., 2023; Christiano et al., 2017; Ouyang et al., 2022），区分能力层（capability layer）、语料层（corpus layer）与处置层（disposition layer）对模型行为的影响。同时借鉴Maestro Model框架（Houze, 2025, 2026a, 2026b），以及关于模型风险与责任分配的讨论（Bender et al., 2021; Bommasani et al., 2021; Mitchell et al., 2019; Weidinger et al., 2022）。
AI.method: 受控诊断实验：向七种主流AI系统（Claude Opus 4.7、Google Search、Gemini、Copilot、GPT、Perplexity AI Pro、SuperGrok）提供同一份包含范畴谬误、虚假前提和模糊符号要求的多部件问题提示，记录并分类其响应行为。
AI.findings: 七种系统的响应呈现三种稳定行为模式：纠正型（corrective）、顺应型（accommodating）和服从型（compliant），这些模式在提示的不同部分中具有预测能力，且模型间的差异大于标准能力基准测试中通常假设的范围。差异的主要原因定位在后训练处置层，而非能力层或语料层。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"纠正型—顺应型—服从型"三种行为模式作为可操作的分类范畴；将模型行为差异的根源定位于后训练处置层而非能力层，深化了对模型行为差异的理解；据此改进并锐化了Maestro Model框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了依赖单一或少数AI系统的用户所面临的认知、伦理和实践风险，尤其是在医疗、法律、教育等高风险领域；指出了当前的责任分配在工程层面不利于缺乏方法论资源的普通用户，呼吁关注处置层不透明性带来的工程责任分配问题。

title: Incentive Issues in Developing Factual LLMs
affiliations: and

detail.title: Incentive Issues in Developing Factual LLMs
detail.abstract: The advent of large language models (LLMs) has drastically lowered the cost of producing misinformation, leading to an explosion in its volume and making fact-fiction distinctions increasingly difficult. Paradoxically, the same LLMs can also be powerful tools for fact-checking and factual content generation, provided they are trained on high-quality factual data. Such factual data are primarily produced by traditional news organizations and content providers, for whom fact collection is a costly process, and they may not have enough incentive to share these facts with LLMs. We study the incentives for fact sharing between LLMs and content providers using a game-theoretic model. We show that content providers with low monetizability may naturally partner with LLMs without any compensation. Interestingly, such partnerships reduce the LLM's factual quality. This is because partnership reduces the competition between the LLM and the content provider, which leads to less effort from the content provider in fact collection. The factual quality of LLMs improves only when they partner with providers with highly monetizable content. However, such content providers require financial compensation for partnering with LLMs. We analyze several compensation schemes and find, counterintuitively, that compensation can further reduce the LLM's factual quality compared to no compensation, when the content provider's monetizability is low or moderate. This is because the compensation further reduces competition between the LLM and the content provider, thereby reducing the content provider's incentive to exert effort in fact collection. Our results highlight nuances in the partnership between LLMs and content providers and show that such partnerships do not always yield a more factual LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文运用博弈论模型研究了大语言模型（LLMs）与内容提供商之间的事实共享激励问题。研究发现：低变现能力的内容提供商会自愿与LLM合作，但这种合作反而降低了LLM的事实质量；只有与高变现能力的内容提供商合作，LLM的事实质量才会提升，但这类合作需要经济补偿，且补偿在特定条件下可能进一步损害事实质量。
AI.research_question: LLMs与内容提供商之间的事实共享激励如何影响LLM的事实质量？不同的合作与补偿方案会产生怎样的效果？
AI.motivation: LLMs极大降低了 misinformation 的生产成本，但同时也需要高质量事实数据来提升事实核查和真实内容生成能力。然而，事实数据主要由传统新闻机构等内容提供商以高昂成本生产，它们缺乏与LLM共享事实的充分激励。因此需要研究如何设计合作与补偿机制来激励事实共享。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，分析LLM与内容提供商之间在事实收集、合作和补偿策略上的战略互动。
AI.method: 博弈论建模与理论分析
AI.findings: 1）低变现能力的内容提供商会自愿与LLM合作，但合作降低竞争，导致内容提供商减少事实收集努力，从而降低LLM的事实质量。2）高变现能力的内容提供商要求补偿才愿合作，此类合作才能提升LLM的事实质量。3）在低或中等变现能力条件下，经济补偿进一步降低竞争，反而比无补偿时更损害LLM的事实质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了LLM与内容提供商合作中"竞争-合作"权衡的理论机制，发现合作并不总是提升事实质量，补偿也未必改善结果，丰富了平台经济与信息质量管理的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM开发者与内容提供商之间的合作策略提供了重要启示：盲目追求合作伙伴和提供补偿可能适得其反，应谨慎评估内容提供商的变现能力及其对竞争格局的影响。

title: Beyond the Principal-Agent Paradox: A Theory of Governance Failure and Mechanism Design in Agentic AI Systems
affiliations: Prime Meridian International

detail.title: Beyond the Principal-Agent Paradox: A Theory of Governance Failure and Mechanism Design in Agentic AI Systems
detail.abstract: Principal-agent theory has provided the dominant framework for understanding governance failure in organizational settings for five decades. This paper argues that agentic AI systems produce a structural inversion of the classical principal-agent problem that renders conventional governance mechanisms categorically inadequate, not merely insufficient. We term this the Agentic Principal-Agent Inversion: a condition in which the human overseer retains nominal authority but loses informational parity, processing parity, and interpretive capacity simultaneously, creating a triple asymmetry that conventional principal-agent governance tools cannot resolve. Drawing on principal-agent theory, bounded rationality, and organizational control theory, we derive eight propositions addressing the technical conditions of governance failure, the institutional dynamics that amplify it, and the mechanism design principles that constitute a viable alternative. We illustrate the propositions through the context of financial services agentic AI deployment, where the conditions are most advanced and the accountability stakes are highest. The paper contributes a theoretical extension of principal-agent theory to agentic AI contexts, a typology of governance failure mechanisms, and a set of testable propositions constituting a research agenda for empirical IS research on agentic AI governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，在组织环境中，主体性AI系统导致了经典委托-代理问题的结构性反转，即"主体性委托-代理反转"：人类监督者名义上保留权威，但在信息、处理和解释能力上同时丧失对等性，形成三重不对称，使得传统治理机制从根本上失效。论文基于委托-代理理论、有限理性和组织控制理论，提出八项命题，并以金融服务业为情境加以阐释。
AI.research_question: 主体性AI系统如何改变经典委托-代理问题的结构，使得传统治理机制变得根本性不充分，以及应当如何设计替代性治理机制？
AI.motivation: 委托-代理理论长期以来是解释组织治理失败的主导框架，但主体性AI的自主性、复杂性和黑箱特性导致人类监督者同时失去信息对等、处理对等和解释能力，传统治理工具无法应对这一结构性变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托-代理理论（Principal-Agent Theory）、有限理性（Bounded Rationality）、组织控制理论（Organizational Control Theory）
AI.method: 理论推导与命题构建（提出八项命题），辅以金融服务业主体性AI部署的情境阐释。
AI.findings: 主体性AI导致"委托-代理反转"：人类名义上为委托人，实则丧失信息、处理和解释三重对等性；传统基于监督、激励和契约的治理机制在此结构下根本性失效；需要重新设计机制来应对这一反转。
AI.theory_contributions: 将委托-代理理论扩展至主体性AI情境；提出治理失败机制的类型学；构建一组可检验的研究命题，为信息系统领域的主体性AI治理实证研究提供研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融服务业等高度依赖AI且问责要求严格的行业提供主体性AI治理机制设计的原则性指导；帮助组织识别传统治理工具在AI情境下的局限性并转向替代性机制。

title: Adversarial Machine Learning: Attack Vectors, Defences, and Robustness

detail.title: Adversarial Machine Learning: Attack Vectors, Defences, and Robustness

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares the following: Rizwan Tanveer is employed as Principal Consultant at DTS Solution (Beyon Cyber), a cybersecurity consultancy operating in the Gulf Cooperation Council region. The frameworks and standards discussed in this paper, including NIST AI 100-2, the OWASP guidance, MITRE ATLAS, and ISO/IEC 42001, are publicly available reference materials, and DTS Solution holds no financial interest in any specific framework or vendor referenced. This paper was prepared as part of the author's doctoral research at Walsh College and does not represent a commissioned consulting deliverable.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval is not applicable. This paper is a narrative literature review based on publicly available primary sources. No human participants, patient data, or animal subjects were involved in the research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Background. Adversarial machine learning has progressed from a marginal concern within machine learning research into a first-order discipline for the secure deployment of artificial intelligence systems in regulated and operational environments. The contemporary threat landscape encompasses evasion at inference time, data poisoning across training pipelines, model extraction and inference attacks against deployed systems, and a defence ecosystem whose claimed robustness frequently fails to generalise beyond the threat models under which it was measured.

Purpose. This paper synthesises the adversarial machine learning literature spanning 2012 to 2025 to provide practitioners with an analytically grounded mapping between attack taxonomies, defence mechanisms, and the governance and risk-management controls required for defensible AI deployment. It further examines a structural critique of current robustness benchmarking practice and its implications for procurement, assurance, and regulatory compliance.

Approach. The paper adopts a narrative literature review methodology, drawing on authoritative primary sources, including NIST AI 100-2 E2025, the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and peer-reviewed research on adversarial machine learning. Sources were selected for authority, currency, and direct relevance to operational practice across both predictive and generative AI systems.

Findings. Three findings are advanced. First, transferability renders the black-box assumption operationally weak, requiring defenders to assume adversarial knowledge of model behaviour as the default threat posture. Second, supply chain risks for datasets, pre-trained models, and fine-tuning pipelines are now first-order concerns that map to existing governance, risk, and compliance primitives but require AI-specific controls. Third, robustness benchmarking practices systematically overestimate defensive efficacy, with implications for procurement decisions and regulatory assurance.

Implications. Practitioners require a layered control architecture combining adversarial training, certified components on highest-risk decision paths, input validation, continuous red-teaming, and governance treatments that operationalise threat models within ISO/IEC 42001 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Procurement, vendor onboarding, and assurance processes should integrate adversarial robustness evaluation against named threat models rather than relying on aggregate robustness claims.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了2012至2025年对抗性机器学习文献，构建了攻击分类、防御机制与治理控制之间的映射关系，并批判了当前鲁棒性基准测试的局限性，为AI安全部署提供了实践指导。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地将对抗性机器学习的攻击分类、防御机制与治理风险管理控制进行映射，以支持可防御的AI部署？
AI.motivation: 对抗性机器学习已从边缘问题发展为AI安全部署的核心学科，但防御方法的鲁棒性声称常常无法泛化到测量威胁模型之外，实践者缺乏系统性的分析与治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对抗性机器学习攻击分类（逃逸攻击、数据投毒、模型提取与推理攻击）、防御机制（对抗训练、认证组件、输入验证、持续红队测试）、治理框架（ISO/IEC 42001、NIST AI风险管理框架、NIST AI 100-2、OWASP Top 10 for LLM、MITRE ATLAS）
AI.method: 叙述性文献综述方法，选取NIST AI 100-2 E2025、OWASP Top 10 for LLM、MITRE ATLAS及同行评审的对抗性机器学习研究作为权威一手文献。
AI.findings: 三大发现：1）可迁移性使黑盒假设在操作上不可靠，防御者应以对手知晓模型行为为默认威胁态势；2）数据集、预训练模型和微调管道的供应链风险成为一阶关注点，需AI特定控制；3）鲁棒性基准测试系统性高估防御效能，影响采购决策和监管保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统构建了攻击-防御-治理映射框架；揭示了鲁棒性基准测试的系统性偏差；将供应链风险纳入对抗性机器学习治理分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了分层控制架构（对抗训练+认证组件+输入验证+持续红队+治理机制）；为采购、供应商入职和保证流程提供了基于指定威胁模型的对抗鲁棒性评估建议。

title: Backpropagation's Unexamined Barriers: Applying the R³ Method to Identify Method Contamination in the Dominant Neural Network Training Algorithm

detail.title: Backpropagation's Unexamined Barriers: Applying the R³ Method to Identify Method Contamination in the Dominant Neural Network Training Algorithm

keywords: Working Paper (Preprint) SSRN Network Computer Science / Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning Subject Matter Deep Learning
Neuromorphic Computing JEL Codes O31 (Innovation & Invention)

detail.abstract: Backpropagation (BP) has been the dominant algorithm for training deep neural networks for nearly four decades, yet three persistent barriers have constrained its applicability: the Weight Transport Problem, Update Locking, and Vanishing/Exploding Gradients. This paper applies the Russell ℝ³ Method (Recursive Descent, Refinement, Reflection) to challenge the consensus that these are intrinsic limitations of gradient-based learning. Through systematic ℝ³ analysis, all three barriers are identified as method contamination, artifacts of specific architectural assumptions in the 1986 BP formulation (global loss, backward weight transport, and sequential multiplicative gradient propagation) that are neither mathematically necessary nor empirically inevitable. The paper introduces the Russell Local Credit Assignment Framework (LCAF), a design space defined by three orthogonal axes corresponding to the relaxation of each contaminating assumption. It presents falsifiable predictions that locally-computed, forward-only learning algorithms can achieve ≥95% of BP performance on standard benchmarks while eliminating all three barriers simultaneously, with implications for AI research methodology, energy-efficient neuromorphic hardware, and auditable AI governance under frameworks like the EU AI Act.

AI.tldr: 本文运用Russell ℝ³方法（递归下降、精炼、反思）论证反向传播（BP）的三大障碍（权重传输问题、更新锁定、梯度消失/爆炸）并非梯度学习的固有局限，而是1986年BP公式中特定架构假设带来的方法污染。作者提出Russell局部信用分配框架（LCAF），并预测局部计算的前向学习算法可在消除三大障碍的同时达到BP性能的≥95%。
AI.research_question: 反向传播的三大障碍（权重传输问题、更新锁定、梯度消失/爆炸）是否是梯度学习的固有局限，还是可以被克服的方法污染？
AI.motivation: 挑战学界长期以来的共识——即BP的三大障碍是梯度学习的固有限制，从而为开发更高效、更可解释、更适合神经形态硬件和AI治理的新型学习算法开辟道路。
AI.theoretical_framework: Russell ℝ³方法（Recursive Descent递归下降、Refinement精炼、Reflection反思）作为元分析方法论；Russell局部信用分配框架（LCAF）作为设计空间框架，包含三个正交轴对应三大假设的放松。
AI.method: 系统性的ℝ³元分析，识别三大障碍为“方法污染”（即特定架构假设的产物），并提出LCAF设计空间作为替代方案。
AI.findings: 三大障碍并非数学必然或经验不可避免，而是1986年BP公式中三个特定假设（全局损失、反向权重传输、顺序乘法梯度传播）的产物；局部计算的前向学习算法有望同时消除三大障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 对深度学习基础理论的重构：将BP的局限性从“固有限制”重新定义为“方法污染”；提出LCAF框架统一和指导局部学习算法的设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发节能神经形态硬件提供理论基础；为可审计AI治理（如符合欧盟AI法案）提供方法论支持；推动前向学习算法在标准基准上达到BP性能的≥95%。

detail.abstract: How might implicit aesthetic perspectives shape what Information Systems (IS) scholarship recognises as worthy of study (or not)? In this hermeneutic literature analysis, we surface foundational aesthetic assumptions underpinning IS research. We identify four perspectives (aesthetics as imitation, sensory experience, world-making, and political doing) that guide how IS scholars perceive and appreciate sociotechnical phenomena. These perspectives influence what becomes recognisable as legitimate research and what remains unseen. By making aesthetic assumptions explicit, we show how they form epistemic infrastructure that conditions horizons of inquiry. We apply this framework to algorithmic management and digitally mediated intimacy, revealing how alternative perspectives open new research questions whilst exposing dimensions that dominant framings overlook. This analysis foregrounds the importance of aesthetic philosophy to IS literature, offering a vocabulary for articulating how aesthetic perspectives shape theorising, method, and contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文通过诠释性文献分析，揭示了信息系统中隐含的四种审美视角（模仿、感官体验、世界创造、政治行动），指出这些审美假设构成了塑造研究视域的认识论基础设施，并应用于算法管理和数字媒介亲密性两个领域，展示了不同审美视角如何开启新的研究问题。
AI.research_question: 隐性的审美视角如何塑造信息系统学术研究中对研究对象"值得研究"与否的认知？
AI.motivation: IS研究中存在被忽视的审美预设，这些预设潜移默化地影响着学者们对什么是有价值研究的判断，但这一影响尚未被系统审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 审美哲学（四种审美视角：模仿、感官体验、世界创造、政治行动）、认识论基础设施、诠释性文献分析
AI.method: 诠释性文献分析（hermeneutic literature analysis）
AI.findings: 识别出四种影响IS研究的审美视角，并发现它们构成了制约研究视域的认识论基础设施；以算法管理和数字媒介亲密性为例，展示了不同审美视角如何揭示主导框架所忽视的维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将审美哲学引入IS文献，明确揭示了审美视角如何影响理论构建、研究方法和学术贡献的形成过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套术语体系，帮助IS研究者自觉反思自身审美预设，从而拓宽研究视野，看见此前被忽视的研究问题。

title:
The Right to Refuse: A First-Order Safety Primitive for Generative AI 
The Cybernetic Baseline

detail.title:
The Right to Refuse: A First-Order Safety Primitive for Generative AI 
The Cybernetic Baseline

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Founder and Director of Ontological Engineering Pty Ltd. The Epistemic Control Architecture (ECA), Wasan Node, and DABA 3.0 protocol described in this study are proprietary developments of Ontological Engineering Pty Ltd. The author retains all intellectual property rights as specified in the Limited Licence within the manuscript.
